criteria.text: Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,600,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
Calculates the long-stop date as 2 March 2027 (90 days after signing on 2 December 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 16 April 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the Netherby Engineering Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Flags that the disclosure letter is inconsistent with the material contract on change of control.
Gives the long-stop period as 90 days and as the date 2 March 2027, with days remaining from 28 December 2026 (64 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
